documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Silkflex Polymers held its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call, highlighting the commencement of full-scale commercial production at its new 10-acre automated Vadodara facility. Management reported strong financial growth for the quarter and full year, driven by operating leverage, cost control, and the transition toward in-house manufacturing of textile binders and table glue. The company outlined priorities for FY2027 including scaling manufacturing capacity utilization to 100%, shifting the revenue mix toward a 50:50 manufacturing-to-trading ratio, and expanding binder applications into non-textile sectors. Silkflex Polymers (India) Limited reported its financial and operational performance for the fourth quarter and full year of FY26, highlighting the transition from a trading model to a manufacturing-led model following the commissioning of its automated facility in Vadodara. Management outlined strategic priorities focused on geographic expansion across garment hubs, volume growth, operational cost optimization, and scaling the wood coating segment.

guidance.claim: Management expects the overall EBITDA margin to increase by 2% to 3% as manufacturing scales.
guidance.quote: So overall EBITDA can increase by 200-300 basis points. If seen overall, we can expect expansion by 2% to 3%.

guidance.claim: The company expects to reach full capacity utilization by the end of financial year 2027.
guidance.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

guidance.claim: Management expects to achieve full capacity of 500 tons per month by the next financial year.
guidance.quote: By looking the demand across the market by next financial year, we will achieve full capacity that we are hoping.

guidance.claim: The company expects manufacturing EBITDA margins to increase to near about 50% according to production.
guidance.quote: Currently our margin in manufacturing is around 25%. And in the coming time, we can expect margins to be near about 50% according to the production.

guidance.claim: At full utilization, the manufacturing capacity can generate a total turnover of around INR70 crores to INR80 crores.
guidance.quote: It will come to around INR70 crores to INR80 crores.

guidance.claim: Expected growth is projected between 15% to 20% in the textile ink market and 20% to 30% in wood coating.
guidance.quote: Rohan, now both the segments are growing exceptionally and I am looking for 15% to 20% in the ink market in the textile market, I mean to say. And for the wood coating market it will be more like 20% to 30% in wood coating.

demand_outlook.claim: The near-term export environment remains somewhat cautious due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.
demand_outlook.quote: From a demand standpoint, the near-term export environment remains somewhat cautioned due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.

demand_outlook.claim: The company stated it is encouraged by improving demand trends in the wood coating segment and expects to selectively expand its market presence.
demand_outlook.quote: Encouraged by improving demand trends, we expect to selectively expand our market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic segment.

demand_outlook.claim: India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintain strong sustainable growth supported by rising domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintaining strong sustainable growth supporting by rising the domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: The recent India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal open significant growth opportunities for Indian textile and furniture exports.
demand_outlook.quote: Thirdly, the recent India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal opens a significant growth opportunities for Indian textile exports as well as furniture exports by eliminating duties on most of the products, narrowing the competitive gap with countries like Bangladesh and Pakistan.

demand_outlook.claim: Both the textile ink and wood coating segments are growing exceptionally.
demand_outlook.quote: Rohan, now both the segments are growing exceptionally and I am looking for 15% to 20% in the ink market in the textile market, I mean to say.

capex_expansion.claim: The Vadodara plant facility is spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet automated setup and an installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month.
capex_expansion.quote: The Facility is spread over 10 acres of land with 72,000 square feet automated setup and the plant has been installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month and operates on a boiler-less, zero-carbon and zero-discharge model, aligned with our sustainability which is the first philosophy.

capex_expansion.claim: Additional machinery will be added over the next couple of months, funded through internal resources.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, we are in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through our internal resources, which will enable us to expand our product portfolio and enter adjacent categories as well.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, marking a shift from trading to manufacturing.
capex_expansion.quote: Commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, marking the company’s strategic shift from trading to a manufacturing-led model to enhance margins, scalability, and operational control.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production commenced at the first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat, spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet automated plant.
capex_expansion.quote: I am pleased to share that this quarter marks a significant milestone for Silkflex Polymers India Limited with the commencement of commercial production at our first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat. Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

capex_expansion.claim: Utilities, cooling plants, and monomer storage capacities have already been installed for further expansion without requiring more capex.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, Ryan. We already set up our factory in a major factors like, you can say utility, cooling plant, monomer storage capacity, already we have been instaledl according to the expansion capacity for the further expansion. So we need not require for more capex.

capex_expansion.claim: Out of the manufacturing capex, INR30 crores is a bank loan, INR10 crores was funded through IPO for land, and the rest from internal accruals and unsecured promoter loans.
capex_expansion.quote: Out of that INR30 crores is our loan from the bank and so far as the INR20 crores, it was funded through IPO to purchase the land for INR10 crores and the rest of the amount from internal accrual and unsecured loan from promoters.

capex_expansion.claim: The expected payback period for the INR40 crores investment in the manufacturing plant is around 4 to 5 years.
capex_expansion.quote: You can consider around you may know between 4 to 5 years.

margins_costs.claim: In-house manufacturing of textile binder and table glue is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%.
margins_costs.quote: With this backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%, reduce our import dependency and enhance supply reliability.

margins_costs.claim: Input costs have remained volatile with raw materials seeing a sharp increase during the year driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.
margins_costs.quote: On the supply side, input costs have remained volatile. To put this in perspective, raw materials saw a sharp increase during the year, largely driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.

margins_costs.claim: The manufacturing segment operates at EBITDA margins of 20% to 25%, while the trading business operates at 12% to 15%.
margins_costs.quote: we can see that the EBITDA margins are around 20%-25% for the manufacturing segment, and for our trading business it is 12% to 15%.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit margin for Q4 FY26 was reported at 33.2%.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Profit Margin (%) 33.2% 39.0% -580 bps 25.0% 820 bps 28.2% 25.8% 240 bps

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q4 FY26 stood at 23.1%.
PAT margin for Q4 FY26 was 11.9%.
Q3 FY26 EBITDA increased by 130.78% year-on-year to INR7.11 crores due to better operating leverage and cost control.
margins_costs.quote: The profitability improved significantly during the quarter with the EBITDA increasing by 130.78% year-on-year to INR7.11 crores. Mainly due to better operating leverage and cost control.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points to 21.2% from 9.7% in Q3 FY25.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points to 21.2% from 9.7% in the quarter 3 from the financial year '25.

margins_costs.claim: Basic raw material prices at the plant have not seen any significant changes in the last 2 years.
margins_costs.quote: In the last 2 years, we haven't seen any significant changes. So, we don't expect too many changes in price movements.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization stood at approximately 60% in the first year of operations.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilization stood at present approximately 60% in the first year of operations and scaling this remains a key priority for FY2027.

orders_capacity.claim: The installed capacity of the new Vadodara manufacturing facility is 500 tons per month.
orders_capacity.quote: Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

orders_capacity.claim: In the first 2 months of manufacturing (November and December), the plant utilized around 60% capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: In first 2 months, that is November and December, after starting the manufacturing, we utilized around 60% capacity.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is confident that working capital will not become a constraint due to internal availability and good cash flow.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we are very confident working capital will not become a constraint at least in the near future.

capital_allocation.claim: Debt reduction is planned to be managed effectively from internal accruals as cash flow generation is very good.
capital_allocation.quote: So, from internal accruals only we will be able to manage it, will be able to do it very effectively. So, we're not very worried about the debt.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's term loan stands at INR30 crores and working capital at INR20 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our term loan is INR30 crores and working capital is INR20 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The net worth of the company stood at around INR42 crores as of December end.
capital_allocation.quote: So by December end our net worth stood at around INR42 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The tenure of the INR30 crores long-term loan taken for the manufacturing plant is 7 years.

risks_headwinds.claim: The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to import costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to our import cost.

management_commitments.claim: Scaling manufacturing utilization and increasing the contribution of manufacturing towards 50% of the revenue mix are key priorities.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead to FY2027, our priorities remain clear: scaling manufacturing utilization, increasing the contribution of manufacturing towards 50% of our revenue mix, expanding binder sales into non-textile industries as well and deepening our engagement with global brands.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to reach full capacity utilization of the manufacturing plant by the end of financial year 2027.
management_commitments.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to launch new products resulting from R&D trials within a couple of months.
management_commitments.quote: So, hopefully we will be coming soon within couple of months, we will intimate to you once again when we will get through.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to establish a presence in various locations throughout India by partnering with selling agents.
management_commitments.quote: Additionally, we plan to establish a presence in various locations throughout India by partnering with selling agents.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets increased sales volume through product portfolio expansion and participation in key industry exhibitions and technical seminars.
management_commitments.quote: Targeting increased sales volume through product portfolio expansion and participation in key industry exhibitions (GMMSA, Knit Show) and technical seminars.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to reduce costs through branch infrastructure sharing, solar energy adoption, and internal efficiencies.
management_commitments.quote: Reducing costs through branch infrastructure sharing, solar energy adoption, and improved internal efficiencies in logistics, inventory, and processes.

management_commitments.claim: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by an advanced and sustainable textile coating facility.
management_commitments.quote: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities.

management_commitments.claim: The moratorium period for the INR30 crores long-term loan is June 2026.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
